seoTitle: Mind Map Maker from an Indented List (SVG)
metaDescription: Turn an indented outline into a coloured mind map SVG. Limit the levels to collapse deep branches. Free, nothing uploaded.
intro: Draws a mind map from an indented list. Each branch from the centre gets its own colour, and you can collapse levels deeper than a number you choose.
why:
Outlines are how most people draft ideas; a map makes the structure visible. Paste an indented list and get a tree growing to the right, with curved links and colours per main branch.

Collapsing is done with the levels option, which replaces the click-to-fold of an interactive map and is therefore usable with a keyboard. Collapsed nodes show a plus count of what is hidden. The outline is also listed in the table as a text version.
howTo: Write the root, then indent children by two spaces.
Use bullets or numbers if you like; they are ignored.
Set levels to show to collapse deeper branches.

faq.a: Indent by two spaces (or a tab) per level.
They are placed under a generic "Map" root.
The mind map maker tool exports an outline; this one draws the picture.
